_note: Ground truth per object for door_room_v0. 'joint' = how run_room.sh opens the door (open = command it sends). 'id' = the Gazebo label on that model (unique per object, 1-255). Classes: 1 = door, 2 = handle. Hinge side and push/pull are seen from the camera side of the wall. World frame: x toward the wall, y left, z up (metres). hinge_world = a point on the hinge axis + its direction, from the hinge joints in door_room_v0.sdf.

camera.frame: ROS optical: x right, y down, z forward
